notes.title: Dynasty of the Sands: Update
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]Hey all,

It's been a while but we have a small update regarding the future of Dynasty of the Sands!

We’re pleased to share that the publishing rights for Dynasty of the Sands have been returned to Rocket Flair Studios from PlaySide Studios. We would like to thank PlaySide for its support, partnership, and funding throughout the game’s development over the past few years. Their contribution has been instrumental in helping us to bring our vision for Dynasty of the Sands to life, and we deeply appreciate the collaboration and guidance that the team at PlaySide have provided, as well as the opportunity to explore new paths to bring the game to players around the world. We hope to share more details around our next steps for Dynasty of the Sands soon. Thank you for your continued support.


More information will be available soon![/p]

notes.title: Development Update | Coming to Steam in Early 2025
notes.notes:
[b]Faithful Subjects,[/b]

While the sands of time may have seemed a little still with development updates over the past few months, our team has been working tirelessly, refining the Dynasty of the Sands gameplay experience, with a focus on significant improvements across the game’s visual and artistic fidelity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36650433/3aabfae24034922895970488ba3bd66314b9688d.png[/img]
We’re excited to share that [i]Dynasty of the Sands[/i] will officially launch on Steam in early 2025! We will share more specific details on our release plans in the new year - so make sure to stay tuned for some big announcements coming soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36650433/fe9cfe50d06dddd68a3328265e8fa98eed27cc88.png[/img]
From breathtaking, lifelike environments to dynamic lighting that brings the ancient Egyptian kingdoms to life, every detail has been overhauled to immerse you deeper into the world of the Pharaohs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36650433/556b0ac5c1ce4088c99618e45ad0065d3bc8cda6.png[/img]
As Pharaoh, you’ll lead your people through harsh deserts, appease the gods, and build a city of unmatched glory. The sands are shifting, Pharaoh—your dynasty awaits. 

Join [url=https://discord.gg/hXY7yBQu]our Discord[/url] to connect with the community and stay updated.

notes.title: Update on Dynasty of the Sands
notes.notes:
Hey everyone. We know you’ve been waiting on a progress update.

Dynasty of the Sands is still in development, but we had to take a short pause due to other commitments. We’ll talk more about these later in the year.

This means that the game will be slightly delayed, and we are looking at announcing the release date in early 2023.

Meanwhile, we have new updates coming soon and have added a lot of features which we will talk about very shortly.

We are very excited about Dynasty of the Sands, and are working hard on making sure to deliver the best game we can.

Expect more regular updates and news from now on and thank you for your support and patience.

notes.title: End of Year Update
notes.notes:
Hey Guys!
Like most people we've had a rollercoaster of a year.

However, Dynasty of the Sands will continue development, we're working on finalizing the terrains, and reworking our emergent events!
We also intend to announce a release date in Q2 next year.

More to come very soon 🙂 Happy holidays from the Team!
